index.html#welcome: Prediction games on Koinos, free to play. Pick producers, blocks and races, and climb the weekly boards.
index.html#play: A few quick questions about the chain, Monday to Saturday. Free to play, guest play works. Correct answers climb the weekly board.
index.html#leaderboard: Every game has its own board. Pick a game below.
index.html#results: How finished games turned out. Pick a game to see each call.
index.html#how: The rules in short. Pick a game's tab to read its rules.
games.html: Every Knode Games game in one place. Pick one to start; most are free to play.
stake.html: Staking is optional, and rewards can be zero. Your VHP goes into one shared vault and you can withdraw it any time.
race.html: Pick the producer you think finishes first, then watch the race run live on real blocks. Free to play.
blockx.html: Pick which producer signs the next milestone block. Free to play. Correct calls climb the weekly board.
bracket.html: Pick the winner of every matchup in a weekly knockout. Free to play. The more you get right, the higher you climb.
golf.html: Your places in other games become your Block Golf score. Free to play. Play the other games and your score builds here.
fantasy.html: Fantasy Producers: draft five producers under a salary cap and name a captain, then send your team.
lastnode.html: Last Node Standing: pick a node. Each hour the unluckiest node is knocked out.
overunder.html: Free test game, no prizes yet. Pick a producer and call whether it signs more or fewer blocks than the number shown. A new game starts every 30 minutes.
vs.html: Knode Games VS: pick which producers beat our node each day. A free test.
combo.html: Build a card of 2 to 10 calls from races and Block X. Every leg has to hit. Free to play.
survivor.html: Pick one producer a day, and you have two lives. Free to play.
swap.html: Swap VHP for KOIN here. A 10% fee applies, so check the amount before you confirm.
get.html: Where to get KOIN and VHP. You can try the games as a guest first.
names.html: Get an @name for your Koinos account and see who owns one.
burn.html: Burn KOIN into VHP for your own wallet. Keep some KOIN for Mana.
mana.html: See what Mana is and how much your account has.
node.html: Paste any Koinos producer address to see whether it is producing and how it is doing.
run-node.html: Want to run your own Koinos node? This guide has 10 steps, each with the exact command.
pulse.html: A live look at the Koinos network.
start.html: New to Koinos? Start here for the basics in plain words.
install.html: Add Knode Games to your phone's home screen.
ruler.html: How we measure producers fairly. Read this to see how games treat unusual races.
seed-sponsor.html: Add VHP to the platform's Seed: donate it for good, or support and withdraw any time. Nicknames only.
trust.html: How Knode Games keeps funds safe and what you can check yourself.
fairness.html: How picks are locked and results are decided, in plain words.
terms.html: The terms for using Knode Games. Please read them before you connect a wallet.
